Place each GID-title gallery folder directly inside the input folder. Choose a separate output folder that does not contain, or sit inside, the input. Use the same storage provider for both selections so folder relationships can be checked.
2. Select a target and review the scan

Choose Loose or CBZ, then tap Scan. The same layout is copied; a different layout is converted. Open any gallery row to inspect its plan or errors. All / Loose / CBZ / Invalid filter the preview only; the batch uses the whole scan plan. Swipe quickly to reveal the draggable scroll thumb.

Tap Start batch after reviewing the plan. Existing output folders are skipped without merging or overwriting. Inputs stay unchanged.\n\nCompleted galleries are kept if you cancel. Scan again to retry unfinished items. A .partial folder or .ehbridge-incomplete marker means an output is unfinished; remove it only after the task stops. Processing can continue with the screen off, but Android may stop it at its background time limit.

A · Loose: at least one numeric page file such as 00000001.webp. The .ehviewer file is optional.

B · CBZ: GID.cbz, with numeric page files at the archive root. Internal ComicInfo.xml is optional.

Page names need at least 8 digits. Page gaps and arbitrary extensions are allowed. Keep each gallery in its own GID-title folder.

Missing .ehviewer does not block loose-gallery copying or A → B conversion. A same-layout copy does not generate this file; CBZ does not retain its download state.

ComicInfo.xml and thumb / thumb.* are optional. Missing outer XML is restored from the CBZ when available, or generated from the folder title and page count. Existing XML bytes are preserved. Missing thumbnails remain absent; repairs are written only to the output.

The advisory-warning menu has a switch for each warning type. These switches affect list and detail visibility only; conversion and exported reports are unchanged.

B → A generates CBOR SpiderInfo. A missing gallery token does not stop conversion, but EhViewer download-list recovery or online resume may be limited. Reading position and per-page tokens cannot be recovered. Images are never decoded or recompressed.

Conversion stays on your device. About-page links open in an external browser. Exported reports contain relative gallery names, file names and status; they exclude gallery tokens, full XML and folder URIs.
The .ehviewer file is missing. Page files can still be copied or packed into CBZ; a same-layout copy does not generate this file.
